protocol.experiment: 1B learned many-to-one core fusion before the graft
protocol.round2_definition: round 2 installs the arm's OWN round-1 window, appends 10 fresh native blocks and compresses 19 -> 9 again; it runs only on rows with at least 29 blocks

unchanged_conditions.data: the same 158 HotpotQA rows as experiments 1, 2 and 1A
unchanged_conditions.source_selection: V10's trained single-point leverage rule, unchanged
unchanged_conditions.output_vectors: native copies on both sides; the fused core is the only non-native vector

protocol.only_difference: the 40 slots a carrier deletes are fused into that carrier's own 216 kept slots before the graft; the graft slots of the fused window are byte-identical to the unfused one

fusion.source: the 40 slots the SAME carrier block deletes
fusion.training: offline, answer-free reader-readout distillation on a disjoint LongBench task; nothing trained here

protocol.operator_note: carrier and graft slots are copied verbatim; no same-block condensation, no orthogonal context delta, no core reinforcement
protocol.pairing_note: both windows come from ONE snapshot and one operator call; the driver checks on every sample that the graft columns are bit-identical, the positions and quota are unchanged, and the core slots did change
protocol.write_stream: document prefix only (the leading template instruction is dropped)
protocol.scoring: official LongBench HotpotQA QA F1 (max over golds); EM; gold-answer log-likelihood
protocol.significance: two-sided exact McNemar on the discordant pairs
protocol.screening_caveat: the rescue/protection groups are selected using the answer and the evidence location, so their accuracies are a mechanism diagnostic and must never be reported as a dataset score; the full-split columns are the honest reference

samples.question: Prior to playing for Michigan State, Keith Nichol played football for a school located in what city?

damage.definition: rows the UNCOMPRESSED window answers correctly; `lost` is how many of them the arm no longer answers

multi_round_group.definition: rows with at least 29 native blocks, so round 2 can compress round 1's 9 blocks plus 10 fresh ones

changed_group.definition: Selection and the trained graft disagree on correctness, i.e. every question the compression changes in either direction

readout.definition: mean reader-readout distance from the uncompressed window at the last 8 question tokens; lower is closer

per_layer.definition: per-layer mean readout distance, graft vs fusion, over the same rows; `removed` is the fraction of the graft distance the fusion takes away, so positive is closer to the uncompressed window
per_layer.note: supervised layers are the ones the loss covered; the rest were never optimised and are the honest test of whether the readout moved

readout.note: the trained taps are the loss the module was optimised on; the held-out layers were never optimised and are the honest test of whether the readout moved or only the probe

dropped_evidence_group.definition: the supporting sentence sits in a block the compression dropped, so only the graft slots can carry it

ungated.definition: every graded sample, no evidence filter

fusion_loses.meaning: deletion was harmless, the fusion breaks it

fusion_recovers.meaning: deletion broke it and the fusion does not

both_lose.meaning: both arms lose the same question

graft_only_fix.meaning: the graft fixes it and the fusion keeps it

graft_fix_fusion_lose.meaning: the graft fixes it, the fusion loses it

fusion_only_fix.meaning: only the fusion arm gets it right

summary.screening_caveat: the rescue/protection groups are selected using the answer and the evidence location, so their accuracies are a mechanism diagnostic and must never be reported as a dataset score; the full-split columns are the honest reference
